units.source_text: 但比起羞于X型的腿来，任何羞耻都不足挂齿了。

en.t: But compared with the shame I felt over my X-shaped legs, any other shame was hardly worth mentioning.

units.source_text: 令我狼狈的，是另一件事。

en.t: What threw me into confusion was something else.

units.source_text: 我明白了我没有性功能的原因。

en.t: I understood the reason why I had no sexual function.

units.source_text: 那种场合我一想到自己的X型的胆即将接触到她的美丽的趋时，我就变得没有性功能了。

en.t: In such situations, the moment I imagined my own X-shaped legs about to touch her beautiful body, I became sexually powerless.

units.source_text: 这一发现，使我确信我决不会被人爱而拥有的平安感从内部世界完全崩溃了。

en.t: This discovery made the peace of mind I had gained from believing I would never be loved collapse completely from within.
